method: Direct visual reading of the original DSKP PDF page images, with its existing text layer used only as an aid. Code, page and year are matched to the prior original-PDF 23-code ledger. No OCR, no text from another year.
scope: 23 unique SP codes in the Year3 RPT index (60 lessons). Statements are visual transcription candidates, not an academic panel signoff.
source_ambiguity: PDF page 35 prints three Year3 SP statements (2.3.1-2.3.3) about the syllable 'المقطع', duplicating SP 2.2.1-2.2.3 even though SK [2.3] specifies 'قراءة الكلمات' (word reading). A fourth SP 2.3.4 in the original PDF has the same issue but is not in the current 60-PdP RPT index. Do not rewrite original standards.
restrictions: Keep all source standards on their exact original PDF pages, with locked PDF SHA-256.
Do not overwrite original DSKP or ledger of 117 SP codes.
Do not transfer another year's statements or infer missing SK text.
Held SP 2.3.1/2.3.2/2.3.3 must remain placeholders in staging previews.
None of 23 SP is academically signed off, no FINAL READY, no Web/Telegram production updates.
